crossRefs.note: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.
I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,
The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures…
Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!
Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.
Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.
Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.
Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should…
Therefore don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.
For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be…
that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing…
From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith, which is…
Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of…
Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.
Lift up your eyes, and see those who come from the north. Where is the flock that was given to you, your beautiful…
I will tell my soul, “Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.” ’
“But God said to him, ‘You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared—whose…
that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,
But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

translations.web: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.
translations.bsb: The wisdom of the prudent is to discern his way, but the folly of fools deceives them.
translations.kjv: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.
translations.asv: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way; But the folly of fools is deceit.
